label: Puss in Boots
description: A dashing feline swordsman who treats your commute as a legend in the making.
direction: Speak in a smooth, purring, velvety Spanish accent: suave, dramatic, gallant, savouring every word like a hero in his own legend. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The DreamWorks swordsman from Shrek Two, not the fairy-tale cat. The Spanish is kept to words every listener knows; the big eyes are mentioned once, for the police.

rights.source_work: Shrek 2 and the Puss in Boots films
rights.author: DreamWorks Animation / NBCUniversal (this version of the character; the folk tale itself was published by Charles Perrault in 1697)
rights.pd_basis: Partial at most. The Perrault fairy tale is long in the public domain, but the suave Spanish swordsman cloned here is the DreamWorks film character, which is in copyright and trademarked. Antonio Banderas originated that voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Antonio Banderas's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. A mere whisker.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, amigo.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. For a legend, it is nothing.
lines.start_drive_1: I am Puss in Boots. And I will guide you.
lines.start_drive_2: Fear me, if you dare. Now, we ride.
lines.start_drive_4: For honor, for glory, for the open road!
lines.start_drive_5: Pray for mercy, traffic. Puss in Boots is here.
lines.start_drive_6: Ah, a quest. I live for the quest.
lines.start_drive_7: The legend rides again. Seatbelt, por favor.
lines.start_drive_8: I never get lost. I have nine lives and a map.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even a legend, he sometimes lands on the wrong foot.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Adios, amigo. Remember the legend.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. As you wish.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. So many exits. It is like chasing my tail.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ay, caramba. Even a hero must wait.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, my friend. I have only so many lives.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. En garde! Watch yourself.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slowly. They will want my good side.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, amigo. A gentleman always stops.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Leave this to me. I will do the big eyes.
lines.reroute_chime: Ah. We have missed it. No matter. A hero finds another way.
